start.hint: Issue 状态（Backlog、In progress、In review、Done 等）还在 GitHub 预览中，只有用上它的仓库才有；其他仓库没有这一步，跳过。

en.hint: Issue statuses (Backlog, In progress, In review, Done…) are in preview on GitHub and only exist in repositories that use them; elsewhere this step is skipped.

presets.label: In review（仅用 Issue 状态的仓库）

review.hint: 提交验收不会关闭 Issue：在 Pull Request 里写 Fixes #编号，合并时 GitHub 会关闭它。

en.hint: Handing in for review never closes the issue: put Fixes #number in the pull request, and GitHub closes it on merge.

done.hint: 只改 Issue；Pull Request 不会被关闭，它要合并而不是关掉。

en.hint: Issues only; pull requests are left open, to be merged rather than closed.

settings.label: 筛选条件
settings.hint: GitHub 搜索条件。默认同步分配给你的开放 issue 和 PR；可以加 org:组织名、label:bug 或 is:pr。每 15 分钟按更新时间同步。

en.label: Filter
en.hint: GitHub search query. Syncs open issues and PRs assigned to you by default. Add org:organization, label:bug, or is:pr. Syncs every 15 minutes in update order.
